taxonomy_prerequisite.reason: A public toilet is a bounded civic service building and a meaningful multilingual search intent. Classifying it only as public-space would hide the facility program, while mixed-use would be incorrect.

excluded.reason: THE TOKYO TOILET is a distributed initiative covering multiple facilities and creators across Shibuya. The CASE concept explicitly analyzes the full network, so assigning it to one canonical building would falsely collapse a system-level reference into a single facility.
excluded.required_resolution: Keep the CASE as a project-level graduation reference outside canonical building migration, or rewrite it around one explicitly selected toilet while preserving the original CASE route and analysis history.
